entries.en: How about the guy in number two? Shoulda heard him screaming last night.
entries.ro: Ce zici de tipul din numărul doi? Trebuia să-l auzi țipând aseară.

entries.en: How are you this fine day, your majesty? Is this treatment working? All those pieces in that little head fitting together?
entries.ro: Ce mai faci azi, măria ta? Tratamentul ăsta chiar merge? Toate piesele alea din capul ăla mic s-au potrivit?

entries.en: Please, just leave me alone... Please, God...
entries.ro: Te rog, lasă-mă în pace... Te rog, Doamne...

entries.en: Jesus Christ, another?! How much do you smoke? A pack a day?
entries.ro: Doamne, Dumnezeule, încă unul?! Cât fumezi? Un pachet pe zi?

entries.en: Uh, the cloud of secondhand smoke? Take it outside!
entries.ro: Păi, norul de fum pasiv? Ia-l afară!

entries.en: All right, I'm going. Just cool your tits, OK?
entries.ro: Bine, mă duc. Ia-o mai ușor, OK?

entries.en: Hmm, down in the dumps today, are we? We'll have to double your dose then. Or just go straight to lobotomy.
entries.ro: Hm, azi suntem mohorâți? Atunci o să-ți dublăm doza. Sau direct lobotomie.

entries.en: He spit out his tabs, so we gave it to him through the "other" end.
entries.ro: A scuipat pastilele, așa că i le-am dat pe „cealaltă” cale.

entries.en: Now when we come in he's already got his tongue out.
entries.ro: Acum, când intrăm, are deja limba scoasă.
